description: This is a 3D model of a multi-arm chandelier, presented in a clean, monochrome white finish. The fixture features a central, classically-shaped body with vertical fluting, from which eight gracefully curved arms extend. Each arm supports a cylindrical lampshade characterized by delicate pleats and a decorative rim at the top. The chandelier is suspended by a linked chain from a simple ceiling plate, embodying a traditional and elegant aesthetic. It's designed to provide ambient lighting and serve as a prominent decorative element.
